title: How to Install Track Lighting: Relocating a Wall Switch, Routing Wiring, and Mounting MR-16 Track Heads
summary: This This Old House tutorial demonstrates a hands-on kitchen-track-light installation focused on choosing track components, relocating a wall switch to feed the new track, routing NM wiring through walls, anchoring to a concrete ceiling, wiring hot/neutral/ground, mounting the switch, and snapping in MR-16 track heads to achieve full room illumination. The presenter notes eight-foot track sections priced around $55 each, MR-16 heads at about $75 each, turning off the existing kitchen breaker, and then executing a step-by-step sequence from wall-work through ceiling mounting to a lighting test.
topics: drilling wall for wiring (1/2 inch spade bit)
tracking cutting methods (reciprocating saw or hex saw)
toggle switch wiring with leads and wire nuts
snap-in track heads and lighting test
